title: Mochizuki Honami — Thinking About Friends〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That melon bun was as good as ever today too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been so obsessed with them lately.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika too. It's amazing how you can both eat pretty much the same thing every single day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's sooo good♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we have P.E. next so we should head back soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. See you after school!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad Saki's back to being her usual self.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think she's been more energetic than usual since she got over the songwriting thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean she's in just that good a mood?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyways, why don't we clean up here and start heading back as well?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, hold on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, would you mind sticking around a little while longer? There's something I want to talk to you about...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There is?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about... Remember how you came chasing after me when we were going home the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Creating our own song, practicing for our show and trying to go pro... It's all making her do this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My dream's forcing her to push herself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I remember you telling me this that time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After that time you said that we wouldn't be able to stay together if we tried to go pro, we had a long discussion concerning that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About whether or not we'd be able to commit to that goal and to our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We each took a long look at ourselves, and we ultimately all decided to walk the same path as you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki too.
She decided that we're going to go pro together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So for now, let's just watch over and place our faith in her, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It might look like she's pushing herself a little too hard right now, but I'm sure she also understands exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you didn't tell me that, I might not have been able get myself to really believe in her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate what you did for me then. Thank you, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad that I'm finally starting to find ways to help you too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially since you're always there to support us and strict with us when you need to be.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm sort of under the impression that we're all square now since you all decided to go pro too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's not true at all. We made the decision to give it a try. We're not actually professionals yet, so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was trying to say that the rest of us still haven't made up for what you have and are always doing for us. I didn't mean for it to sound so weird.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I wouldn't have wanted to hear it any other way. Just honest and straightforward...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be relying on you much more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It really feels like we've taken an important step forward as a band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: From what Saki wrote for us, to that song we all made together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Someday, I hope we'll be able to create another song together that's just as special as that first one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope so too.
